author: SilasVale
body: I'm a t11 mage, and I'll answer any questions you might have =P I'll say that you're hindering yourself A LOT by not raiding apollyon. Going into t10, you pretty much want at least 2 pieces of apollyon gear ornate, if not more.

author: runningxamok
body:
That is quick, you must have min- maxed like a savage.

If you like your kingdom stay with it, but you need to push people to battle and recruit stronger people to build it up.

author: Maudeth
body:
Did something similar, and was in a smaller kingdom as well. Helped them level, and when I eventually hit my 225, I left. The difference between an active vs non is night and day. 

More information. More raids. More interaction. More challenges. It isnt just that you're leaving your old kingdom mates behind, which you already technically have due to level gap, it has to do with your own development and enjoyment of the game itself.

author: eightysix
body:
I am bahamut (lv 221), and have a balor crown... It has been the only thing that I have gotten that is somewhat respectable.  It is my worst piece of gear, but I have used it to raid polly for other gear in hopes that the gods of random gift me with better gear. 

That said, its fine for most of T9.

I would also say, there are kingdoms with absolutely amazing discords.  If you are at the max on your kingdom, it may be worth reaching out and joining a larger kingdom with your friends.

author: AllOrganicCoughDrop
body: How'd you level up so fast?

author: TheOldDrunkBear
body:
You need a better Kingdom.

It literally makes all the difference in the world.

Stay friends with the ones your with, but you need to get in a better/more competitive kingdom RIGHT now.

I was in a little fish kingdom for a long time, we would turn over the raids once every few days, high level ones like Polly and Morri a few weeks would go by.

Now I'm in a kingdom where we turn them over a couple times a day. 

Monthly special raids get done so often i miss most of them... If you really want to play hard, find a kingdom who does too.

(BTW, This is not an advertisement for the kingdom I'm in, but if you're interested, pm me and I'll let you know what's up. Sounds like you'd be a good fit.)

author: dr4kun
body:
You absolutely want to join a kingdom that has raids relevant to you unlocked and whose overall pace is similar to yours. 

As you grind through t9, you will have enough orns to unlock some supplementary classes or even switch away from mage altogether. Keep an eye on your gear and all drops you get on the way, and consider sliding into t10 as something else than heretic.
